messages:
Srija: Day 2 check-in — What I did: got GitLab access, ran quickstart app locally, built model docker image locally. Blockers: 1) SSH to jumpbox gives "Permission denied (publickey)", 2) kubeconfig from console is missing cluster certs (errors when kubectl apply), 3) CI model-build job failing with OOM on layer, looks like memory blowup. PR that needs review: https://git.redwood.com/infra/patches/-/merge_requests/42
Leah (Onboarding): Thanks — can you paste the exact SSH error and the `kubectl` error? I'll loop infra in. :wave:
Srija: SSH error: `ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_redwood ubuntu@jump.redwood.internal` -> "Permission denied (publickey)". Kubectl: `error: tls: failed to verify certificate` when I run `kubectl get ns`
infra-bot: Note: jump.redwood.internal only accepts connections from corporate IP ranges. If you're on home network, you'll need VPN on. See https://runbook.redwood.internal/jumpbox-access
Devon: I can pair on the CI OOM. Quick ask: what base image are you using? Some of the model layers blow up with default Docker memory. Try adding `--shm-size=1g` or bump the build node memory in `.gitlab-ci.yml`.
Sanjay: Added SSH key for `srija@redwood` to jumpbox auth. Try now. Also filed an internal ticket to upload cluster certs to the onboarding bucket, you should be able to get kubeconfig with `gcloud container clusters get-credentials redwood-dev --zone us-central1-a` if you have GCP access.
Srija: Re-ran SSH after key addition: `ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_redwood ubuntu@jump.redwood.internal` -> connected, greeted by motd. :tada:
Leah (Onboarding): Nice! For the kube certs, check the onboarding bucket link I DM'd. If `gcloud` still errors, paste `kubectl --v=8 get ns` output.
Srija: `kubectl --v=8 get ns` now returns namespaces, kubeconfig works. CI still failing on model build, pushing a small change to MR 42 to add `--shm-size=2g` and increase build machine ram. @Devon can you take a look when you have a slot? :eyes:
Devon: I'll jump on a 30-min pairing session in ~20m. I'll try the `--shm-size` tweak and also check caching layers — sometimes pip wheel installs explode memory. I'll post notes in the MR.
Srija: Thanks everyone — I'll run `make test-quick` once CI succeeds and ping this thread. :thumbsup:
Leah (Onboarding): Awesome progress. If anything else blocks access, ping me and I'll escalate. Welcome aboard! :sparkles:
